item.title: Waste Not Want Not
item.description: Behind an unmarked door at a busy shopping mall in Durban, 19-year-old Aphiwe is knee-deep in cardboard boxes. When her flat-packed stack reaches five feet high — almost as tall as she is — it’s ready to be sold. For Aphiwe, every box is more than trash. It’s money for food, transport, and medicine for her family.

item.title: Blindsided
item.description: Abiodun Oyeniran lost his sight completely at age 21. At 28, he finally makes it into the University of Lagos, only to realise the campus is not equipped to fully support the needs of blind students. So, Abiodun becomes an accidental activist, creating a grassroots system that helps visually impaired students navigate exams for 5 years—until the university decides his solution is a threat to their policy and shuts it down.
